what: Spec gate round 1: the sweep scoped run-wide replacement Thens but left a bare whole-file unchanged Then in twelve scenarios, which the suite reads as the final state and an approved offer of the other addition would contradict. Swept every bare instance; each now asserts the section its Given names is byte-identical. The scenario map row for the owner-says-theirs path was brought in line with its scoped Given.

Spec gate round 2 found that scoping whole-file Thens to one section, the round-1 fix, dropped the only check that a run offering nothing writes nothing, and missed three until-answered Thens. Regression of the round-1 fix, so re-planned rather than patched: every whole-file Then is restored as frozen and the Given settles the other addition instead, by holding its current text or by scoping to the run only offer or question. Then references made ambiguous by the added Given line now name their section.

Spec gate round 3: the sweep missed an offer-display scenario whose Then said the offer shows the existing section, which the other addition offer cannot meet. Swept every Then naming an unqualified offer; the replacement-display and verbatim-offer Thens now name the Delegation offer. Iteration cap of three reached; one confirmation round run on this mechanical fix rather than auto-accepting.

Spec gate confirmation round: one more unqualified-offer Then in the root-path scenario disagreed with the node rule. It now asserts the destination for each offer, which covers both additions without weakening the claim.
